acceptanceCriteria: Timeout sends SIGINT first, waits a configurable grace (--interrupt-grace, documented default), then SIGTERM/SIGKILL, covered by a fake runner that writes a file on SIGINT
The receipt records which signal ended the run
--server-ready-url help text matches behavior (or readiness accepts what the help says, including redirects), covered by a test
body: GitHub #1133. On --timeout the owned process group gets SIGTERM then SIGKILL after ~100 ms; Playwright only runs reporters' onEnd on SIGINT, so with --keep-reporters a timed-out run loses per-run manifests of finished tests. Also: --server-ready-url help says status < 500 but readiness accepts only 2xx and does not follow redirects (a 302 never becomes ready).
title: GH #1133: js-test-provider --timeout should SIGINT first with a configurable grace so Playwright reporters' onEnd runs; fix --server-ready-url help
